inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026 actual (year ended 2026-08-31), 10-K filed 2026-10-20. Replaces the 2026-09-28 build's estimate of 2,468.0 (9M actual + Q4 at the top of guidance); the actual beat the top of the $2.45-2.47B range by $6M.
inputs.share_count_basis: Cover-page shares outstanding 35,255,660 at 2026-10-15 (FY2026 10-K) plus 0.145M common-stock equivalents from the FY2026 diluted-EPS table (diluted 36.612M less basic 36.467M weighted). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so charging dilution too would double-count. The actual count fell 6.3% in FY2026 (37.65M to 35.26M at year end) on $644M of buybacks; that is upside the flat-count convention does not credit beyond the refreshed starting count.
inputs.net_debt_note: FY2026 10-K debt note (2026-08-31): total debt $1,370.0M carrying value = current $499.4M (the $500M 2027 Notes, due 2027-03-01) + long-term $870.6M ($375M 2025 Term Facility + $500M 2032 Notes, net of issuance costs); face value $1,375M. Cash and equivalents $233.3M. Investments of $32.0M (current) are NOT netted: small, and not established as freely available. Net debt rose $35M from the 2026-05-31 anchor because Q4 buybacks ($138M) plus dividends exceeded Q4 free cash flow. Metrics.csv has no FY2026 row yet and its Q3 2026 total_debt is a different figure from the 10-Q carrying value used in the prior build; neither affects this valuation, which reads the 10-K directly.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 10-K cash-flow statement: stock-based compensation expense $84.099M (FY2025 $61.229M), plus $6.936M of share repurchases to satisfy tax withholding on vesting awards (FY2026 10-K share-repurchase table; FY2025 $16.242M, FY2024 $16.659M, FY2023 $13.709M). No company-published combined figure exists, so the two lines are summed. The prior build added no withholding because the XBRL tag stops at FY2022; the 10-K table shows the outflow continued. 3.4% of revenue for SBC alone, 3.7% including withholding. FY2026 SBC includes one-time CEO onboarding equity under the employment agreement.
inputs.fcf_note: reported_fcf FY2026 = OCF $822.2M less capex $114.7M = $707.5M (the company's own free-cash-flow reconciliation). Owner FCF = 707.5 - 91.0 SBC incl. withholding - 0 interest income = 616.5. FY2026 OCF was helped by a $62.6M rise in accrued compensation (ASV-linked incentive accruals and restructuring not yet paid), part of which reverses in FY2027; the forward build does not carry it because flows are rebuilt from components.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2026 interest income $4.1M (FY2025 $6.5M). Not stripped: the company is net DEBT ($1.14B), so no cash pile is added to EV and there is nothing to double-count.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 repurchases under the programme $643.961M for 2,608,284 shares (FY2025 $300.5M), financing-activity cash, plus $6.1M of excise tax. Buybacks exceeded owner FCF less dividends ($164M), funded by drawing cash down $104M. The flat count is funded several times over; buybacks are value-neutral in this model because SBC is already deducted.
inputs.wacc_rationale: UNCHANGED from the 2026-09-28 build. USD flows, USD rate. Rf 4.2% (10y UST) + beta 0.9 x 5.0% ERP = 8.7% cost of equity; pre-tax cost of debt ~5.0%, 4.0% after tax; weights ~89% equity / 11% debt -> 8.1%, used as 8.0% in all three scenarios (risk is charged once, in the scenario paths and weights, not in per-scenario WACCs). The risk-free rate was not re-sourced for this update; a move of more than ~50bp in the 10-year, or the March 2027 refinancing of the $500M notes pricing well away from ~5%, would move it.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (office space, data centres) stay inside EBITDA as an operating expense under US GAAP presentation; lease liabilities ($172.4M) are NOT added to net debt. One treatment, applied consistently.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing row 1: subscription data/software operating company, US filer, USD flows, no leases in the bridge, no NCI, no dual currency; owner-fcf-adaptations.md does not apply). No bank, REIT, insurer or NAV characteristics: no deposits, no investment property, value is a subscription cash-flow stream. Same model as the 2026-09-28 build. THIS IS AN UPDATE of that build: anchors refreshed to the FY2026 10-K (base revenue, net debt, share count, SBC incl. withholding), and year-1 growth and the early-year margin path re-judged against FY2027 guidance issued 2026-09-30 and reaffirmed at the 2026-11-10 Investor Day; everything else is deliberately unchanged (see reconciliation.unchanged). EBITDA margin paths are PRE-SBC (SBC is charged separately via sbc_pct_path): FY2026 actual (operating income 700.0 + D&A 180.8 + SBC 84.1)/2,476.3 = 39.0%, depressed by ~2.5pp of restructuring, CEO onboarding and other discrete charges (adjusted operating margin 34.5% vs GAAP 28.3%; the gap beyond ~2.8pp of intangible amortisation is one-off). FY2027 guidance: GAAP operating margin 31.0-32.0% (midpoint 31.5%) + D&A ~7.2% + GAAP SBC ~3.4% = ~42.1% pre-SBC EBITDA, the base year-1 anchor. D&A FY2026 $180.8M = 7.3% of revenue, of which ~2.8pp is acquired-intangible amortisation. Capex FY2026 $114.7M = 4.6% of revenue. Cash taxes paid FY2026 $122.7M = 18.9% of pretax income, 17.5% of operating income (FY2025 $103.2M, FY2024 $157.0M); GAAP effective rate 17.9% -> the 18% to 20% cash-tax ramp is unchanged. Working capital: deferred revenue rose $13.0M and receivables absorbed $34.6M on $155M of revenue growth; net capture stays 3% of the revenue change. Horizon 10 years. Terminal: max(0, min(Gordon, cap x FCF_N)), cap 20x base/bull, 15x bear. Year-1 base sanity check: revenue 2,612 -> EBITDA 1,097 -> EBIT 815 (31.2%) -> unlevered owner FCF ~735 (28.1% of revenue) vs FY2026 levered owner FCF 616.5 plus ~45 of after-tax interest = ~661 unlevered; the step is the guided ~3pp GAAP margin recovery (~+100 after tax) less the accrued-compensation inflow that does not repeat.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2027 base-year growth set at 5.5%, the midpoint of FY2027 revenue guidance ($2,600-2,625M on a $2,476.3M base = 5.0-6.0%), consistent with guided organic ASV growth of 5.0-6.5% and the 5.9% 3-yr revenue CAGR. Equity CAGR is not the anchor: the 5-yr figure is a capital-allocation artefact (see warning).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: 5-yr equity CAGR (14.5%) diverges >30% from 5-yr revenue (9.2%) and EPS (7.1%): buybacks were suspended in FY2022-23 to repay CUSIP Global Services acquisition debt, so book value compounded faster than the business. The 3-yr figures are within tolerance (equity 7.3%, revenue 5.9%, EPS 6.6%) and equity FELL 8.4% in FY2026 as $644M of buybacks exceeded retained earnings. Not a growth signal either way.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs measured FY2023->FY2026 (3-yr) and FY2021->FY2026 (5-yr) on 10-K actuals; the prior build measured to FY2025 because FY2026 was then an estimate. FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series = reported FCF less cash-flow SBC less tax-withholding share repurchases (interest income not stripped: net debt since FY2022, and pre-FY2022 net cash was well under 1x FCF): 444.5 (FY21), 424.9 (FY22), 509.1 (FY23), 534.5 (FY24), 540.1 (FY25), 616.5 (FY26). The prior build's series omitted withholding for FY2023-25. Owner-FCF 3-yr CAGR equals reported (6.6%): SBC plus withholding grew in line with cash flow over FY2023-26 (75.7 -> 91.0). The 5-yr owner CAGR 6.8% is below reported 7.5% because SBC plus withholding nearly doubled over FY2021-26 (49.4 -> 91.0) against 43% growth in reported FCF: a rising share of reported cash flow is being paid for in stock. The 5-yr revenue CAGR of 9.2% includes the March-2022 CUSIP Global Services acquisition and is not an organic rate.

base.growth_rates_note: Year 1 changed 6.0 -> 5.5 (FY2027 revenue guidance midpoint). Years 2-10 unchanged.
base.ebitda_margin_path_note: Years 1-4 changed from 40.0/40.5/41.0/41.5 to 42.0: FY2027 GAAP operating margin guidance of 31.0-32.0% puts pre-SBC EBITDA at ~42.1% already, so the recovery the prior build spread over five years is guided to arrive in one. The 42.0% maturity level from year 5 is UNCHANGED: the Investor Day target of adjusted operating margin of at least 36% by FY2029 (+1pp on FY2027) is not credited in the base until delivered; it sits in the bull path.
base.narrative: FY2027 lands at the midpoint of guidance: revenue +5.5% and a GAAP operating margin of ~31.5% as FY2026's restructuring and CEO-onboarding charges drop out, which is a 42% pre-SBC EBITDA margin. Organic growth then holds 5.5% through FY2029, a small haircut to management's ~6% medium-term algorithm, and fades to 2.5% over the decade as AI-augmented upsell and enterprise contract restructuring offset modest seat attrition. The EBITDA margin is held at 42% rather than extended to the Investor Day target; operating margin still drifts up ~1.5pp as acquired-intangible amortisation rolls off and SBC eases from 3.6% to 3.0% of revenue.

bull.growth_rates_note: Year 1 changed 8.0 -> 6.5 and year 2 8.0 -> 7.5: guidance reaffirmed on 2026-11-10, three weeks before the end of fiscal Q1, caps FY2027 revenue at +6.0%, and subscription revenue lags ASV, so 8% cannot arrive before FY2028 at the earliest. Years 3-10 unchanged.
bull.ebitda_margin_path_note: Years 1-4 changed from 40.5/41.5/42.5/43.5 to 42.5/43.0/43.5/44.0 (year 1 = top of FY2027 GAAP margin guidance, 32.0%). The 44.5% maturity level is UNCHANGED and now arrives in year 5 as before.
bull.narrative: AI is net accretive: FY2027 beats the top of guidance (organic ASV at or above the 6.5% high end after 7.0% in FY2026), and growth re-accelerates to 7.5% as clients on FactSet AI solutions (growing ASV ~50% faster) become the majority of the book, the Google Gemini agents and the Claude data connector make FactSet the audited data layer for agentic finance, and wealth and data solutions outgrow the desktop. Management over-delivers its Investor Day target of at least 36% adjusted operating margin by FY2029 and operating leverage takes the pre-SBC EBITDA margin to 44.5%.

bear.growth_rates_note: Year 1 changed 3.0 -> 4.5: year-end ASV of $2,565M is already 3.6% above FY2026 revenue, so 3% would need ASV to shrink during the year; 4.5% is a miss of the guided 5.0% low end. Years 2-10 unchanged.
bear.ebitda_margin_path_note: Years 1-5 changed from 39.0/38.0/37.0/36.0/35.5 to 41.5/40.0/38.5/37.0/36.0 (year 1 = just under the low end of FY2027 GAAP margin guidance, 31.0%). The erosion now starts from the guided level, runs 1.5pp a year instead of 1pp, and reaches the UNCHANGED 35.0% floor in year 6 as before.
bear.narrative: The AI-disruption thesis is right, just early: FY2027 is protected by the ASV already on the book, but LLM tools commoditise data retrieval and screening, seat counts shrink at renewal even as retention stays above 95% (fewer seats per client, not fewer clients), Bloomberg and LSEG outspend FactSet in the AI arms race and price compression arrives when the multi-year enterprise agreements signed in FY2026 come up for renewal. Nominal revenue stalls after FY2028 while defensive AI spend, ASV-linked incentive pay and data-licensing inflation grind the pre-SBC EBITDA margin from the guided 41.5% down to 35%. Sell-side ASV adds cyclical downside on a capital-markets slowdown. No solvency risk: net debt ~1.2x EBITDA, though the $500M 2027 Notes need refinancing by March 2027.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2027 at guidance midpoint (+5.5% revenue, ~31.5% GAAP operating margin); 5.5% growth through FY2029 fading to 2.5%; pre-SBC EBITDA margin held at 42%; SBC 3.6% easing to 3.0% of revenue; 20x FCF terminal cap at 2.5% growth.
scenario_narratives.bull: FY2027 above the top of guidance, then AI-led re-acceleration to 7.5% growth with operating leverage to a 44.5% pre-SBC EBITDA margin; 3% terminal growth.
scenario_narratives.bear: FY2027 just misses guidance, then structural seat erosion from LLM tools: revenue flat from FY2029, margin down to 35%, 1% terminal growth, 15x cap.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: UNCHANGED from the 2026-09-28 build. Bear held at 25% against the 15% house default: AI commoditisation is a credible structural (not cyclical) risk that halved the stock earlier in 2026, and one year of 7.0% organic ASV growth with FY2027 guided lower (5.0-6.5%) does not settle it, because seat erosion would show at multi-year renewals, not in the first year. Bull held at 25% against the 35% default: it needs durable ASV re-acceleration above 7% AND margin expansion beyond management's own FY2029 target. Base 50%: guidance reaffirmed on 2026-11-10 and 95%+ retention make mid-single-digit compounding the central case. What would move them: two consecutive quarters of organic ASV growth below 5% or visible price compression on renewals (bear up); organic ASV growth above 7% sustained through FY2027 with the adjusted margin tracking to 36% (bull up, bear down).

valuation_philosophy.summary: FactSet is valued as a mature, high-retention subscription compounder on a strict owner-FCF basis: SBC plus tax withholding on vesting awards (3.7% of revenue in FY2026) is expensed, the share count is held flat at the post-buyback level, and the flows are rebuilt from components so that neither FY2026's restructuring-depressed margin nor its accrued-compensation cash inflow is carried forward. Year 1 is anchored on FY2027 guidance; the base case credits the guided margin recovery but not the Investor Day expansion target. The central question is whether AI erodes or entrenches the seat, and it is expressed in the growth and margin paths, not in the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: AI/LLM commoditisation of data retrieval shrinks seats per client at renewal; retention above 95% can coexist with falling ASV per client

The base case now takes the guided FY2027 margin recovery (GAAP operating margin 28.3% to ~31.5%) as given; FY2026 missed its own GAAP margin guidance (28.3% vs 29.5-31.0%) on restructuring and incentive pay, so a repeat is the most direct threat to year 1
SBC rose 37% in FY2026 on 6.7% revenue growth; every 1pp of revenue in SBC is ~$26M/yr of owner FCF, and the path assumes it eases to 3.0%
FY2026 free cash flow was flattered by a $62.6M rise in accrued compensation; cash conversion in FY2027 may look weaker than earnings
Sell-side ASV is cyclical with investment-banking headcount
Acquisitions (Irwin, LiquidityBook in FY2025, $348M) are not in the FCF path; a return to deal-making would reduce net cash generation
$500M 2027 Notes mature 2027-03-01; refinancing cost and any change in leverage are not modelled
Terminal value is the majority of EV at an 8% WACC; the 20x cap on a 2.5% Gordon is what bounds it
